name: Han Chen
bio: Han Chen (韓縝; Han Zhen; 1019–1097) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 凤箫吟・芳草 (Feng xiao yin / Fang cao)
poems.author: Han Chen
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
锁离愁，连绵无际，来时陌上初熏。
绣帏人念远，暗垂珠泪，泣送征轮。
长亭长在眼，更重重、远水孤云。
但望极楼高，尽日目断王孙。
消魂。
池塘别後，曾行处、绿妒轻裙。
恁时携素手，乱花飞絮里，缓步香。
朱颜空自改，向年年、芳意长新。
遍绿野，嬉游醉眠，莫负青春。
